obligations.description: A phrase marker must preserve ordered hierarchical constituents and not create crossing immediate-dominance relations.
Subject/predicate and complement/modifier are functions derived from category and sister position, not extra node labels.
Conjuncts of a coordinate phrase must have compatible category; coordination creates a multi-headed exception.
The lexical verb's complementation feature must license object and predicative complements.
E is an elision marker and not a movement gap or fabricated overt word.
Auxiliary fronting leaves an abstract lower position; do-support when required.
Count/mass noun contexts may require an unfilled DET category; do not fabricate an article.
Clausal complements/adjuncts must be correctly positioned and distinguished from nominal complements.
Fronted wh must be related to a licensed gap; do not assume Penn SBARQ equals B-R S-double-bar.
Controlled nonfinite subjects and movement gaps must preserve antecedent/co-indexation relations.
